::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Representation pipeline"}
Details the path from IDs to initial states, then contextualized states and logits.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    n_token-context(["Token-ID context"])
    n_embedding-lookup["Embedding lookup"]
    n_token-embeddings(["Token embeddings"])
    n_positional-information(["Positional information"])
    n_initial-hidden-states(["Initial hidden states"])
    n_transformer-block-input(["Transformer-block input"])
    n_block-update["Residuals, normalization, and MLP"]
    n_contextualized-hidden-states(["Contextualized hidden states"])
    n_final-hidden-states(["Final hidden states"])
    n_vocabulary-projection["Vocabulary projection"]
    n_logits(["Logits"])
    n_token-context -->|is consumed by| n_embedding-lookup
    n_embedding-lookup -->|produces| n_token-embeddings
    n_token-embeddings -->|is combined by| n_initial-hidden-states
    n_positional-information -->|is combined by| n_initial-hidden-states
    n_initial-hidden-states -->|produces| n_transformer-block-input
    n_block-update -->|produces| n_contextualized-hidden-states
    n_contextualized-hidden-states -->|produces| n_final-hidden-states
    n_final-hidden-states -->|is consumed by| n_vocabulary-projection
    n_vocabulary-projection -->|produces| n_logits
```

<details class="computational-graph-text-alternative">
<summary>Text alternative</summary>

<ul>
<li><strong>Token-ID context</strong>: Ordered sequence of IDs conditioning the next prediction.</li>
<li><strong>Embedding lookup</strong>: Retrieves a learned vector for each token ID.</li>
<li><strong>Token embeddings</strong>: Initial vectors associated with token IDs, before contextualization.</li>
<li><strong>Positional information</strong>: Information that lets the model distinguish positions in the sequence.</li>
<li><strong>Initial hidden states</strong>: States formed from embeddings and positional information, before Transformer blocks.</li>
<li><strong>Transformer-block input</strong>: States received by a given block; Q/K/V projections are computed from these states.</li>
<li><strong>Residuals, normalization, and MLP</strong>: Combines the attention output with residual connections, normalization, and the MLP sublayer.</li>
<li><strong>Contextualized hidden states</strong>: States transformed by the blocks; each block receives the previous block&#x27;s states and recomputes its Q/K/V projections.</li>
<li><strong>Final hidden states</strong>: Contextualized states at the output of the final block.</li>
<li><strong>Vocabulary projection</strong>: Projects each final state to one score per vocabulary token.</li>
<li><strong>Logits</strong>: Unnormalized vocabulary scores computed at each position.</li>
</ul>

<ol>
<li><strong>Token-ID context</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Embedding lookup</strong></li>
<li><strong>Embedding lookup</strong> — produces → <strong>Token embeddings</strong></li>
<li><strong>Token embeddings</strong> — is combined by → <strong>Initial hidden states</strong></li>
<li><strong>Positional information</strong> — is combined by → <strong>Initial hidden states</strong></li>
<li><strong>Initial hidden states</strong> — produces → <strong>Transformer-block input</strong></li>
<li><strong>Residuals, normalization, and MLP</strong> — produces → <strong>Contextualized hidden states</strong></li>
<li><strong>Contextualized hidden states</strong> — produces → <strong>Final hidden states</strong></li>
<li><strong>Final hidden states</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Vocabulary projection</strong></li>
<li><strong>Vocabulary projection</strong> — produces → <strong>Logits</strong></li>
</ol>

</details>
